scope: Cupertino-first, then the 10-15 mile ring: Campbell, Los Gatos, Los Altos, Portola Valley, Palo Alto, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Milpitas, Saratoga. Only rows whose lunch service was read on a page that was actually fetched this pass are listed; every other candidate is recorded as a cross-check or a rejection.
method: Every candidate name was first grepped against a 1031-key dedupe index built from the master list plus the rejected list. Survivors were searched ('<name> <city> lunch menu'), then the restaurant's own site or its own online-ordering menu was fetched. Prices are printed only where they were read on the restaurant's own page; prices seen only in press or review text are quoted in flags and left out of the price columns.

Oren's Hummus Palo Alto (261 University Ave) and Oren's Hummus Express (855 El Camino Real, Ste 162) are genuinely absent from the master list, which carries only the Mountain View store. They were NOT added this pass because no page controlled by the restaurant was fetched and no lunch special was evidenced - only Yelp hour grids. Held for a later pass rather than guessed at.

Clara's Junction (Santa Clara) advertises a $19 two-course lunch Mon-Fri 11am-3pm on its own site, which is a textbook qualifying special - but the venue is already row-for-row in the master list, so it was left alone rather than duplicated. The current official wording and PDF link were re-read this pass and match: 'Includes soda, lemonade or iced tea plus your choice of one Starter and one Main. Available Monday - Friday from 11am - 3pm.'

Elia (276 E Campbell Ave, Campbell) remains deliberately unlisted: LUNCH-FLAG-98 holds it as a possible rebrand of Opa! (row L532). No new evidence either way was found this pass, so it stays a flag and not a row.

Saratoga, California was searched directly and produced no new qualifying venue - the four Saratoga restaurants that surfaced (Bella Saratoga, Big Basin Cafe, Big Basin Burger Bar, The Basin) are all already listed, and The Basin's own hours are dinner-only ('Monday - Sunday: 5:00pm - Close'), so it has no lunch service to record.
